packageRules.description: The coordinator's Ruby is pinned in three files under three managers: mise.toml (mise), coordinator/.ruby-version (ruby-version) and the Dockerfile's RUBY_VERSION ARG (dockerfile). Renovate links none of them, so solo bumps land as separate PRs and leave the image on a different Ruby than CI. One group, one PR. Keep .ruby-version bare (4.0.9, not ruby-4.0.9): Renovate's ruby-version manager silently skips the prefixed form, verified by local dry-run 2026-11-15.
